description:
McDonald Property, Lucan’s longest-established auctioneers, valuers and estate agents, are delighted to present Oak Lawns to the market.

This detached bungalow occupies an exceptional site extending to approximately 0.86 acres and offers generous accommodation together with considerable scope for a new owner to create a home suited to their own requirements.

Set in a peaceful country-style setting close to the Royal Canal, Oak Lawns enjoys a high degree of privacy while remaining within easy reach of Lucan Village and a wide range of transport, recreational, employment and educational amenities.

Lucan Village is approximately 2km from the property, while Leixlip Confey Railway Station is approximately 2.4km away, providing regular rail services and convenient commuting options. St. Catherine’s Park is less than 1km from the property and extends to approximately 200 acres of woodland, grassland and riverside walks along the River Liffey.

The property is also conveniently located for major employment and educational centres, including Intel and Maynooth University, while Dublin City’s O’Connell Street is approximately 17km away. Train from Leixlip Confey Railway Station to Dublin’s Connolly Station is a 30 minute journey.

Oak Lawns combines a peaceful and private setting with convenient access to Lucan, Dublin and the surrounding area, offering the opportunity to enjoy a more spacious and tranquil lifestyle while remaining close to the amenities and conveniences of everyday urban life.

The bungalow extends to approximately 182 sq. m. and provides spacious and versatile accommodation. The existing layout offers scope for reconfiguration to suit individual requirements, subject to the necessary planning permissions where applicable.

The accommodation currently comprises an entrance porch, entrance hall with storage closet, living room, dining room, kitchen, utility room, bathroom, WC room, four bedrooms, one of which is currently used as a sitting room, second bathroom, kitchenette and an additional sitting room/ additional bedroom.

The accommodation is presently arranged to provide a main residence with three/ four bedrooms together with a separate independent living area (flat) one-bedroom living area with own door access from garden, offering flexibility for a variety of living arrangements.

Outside, the property is approached via a gravel driveway providing generous off-street parking. The front and rear gardens are laid mainly in lawn and feature a mature selection of shrubs and trees. There is also a garage building with adjoining boiler shed, outdoor toilet, together with additional outbuildings.

The property is held within Folio DN19244 and extends to approximately 0.35 hectares (0.86 acres) in total.

Viewing is strictly by appointment only.

Utility Room: 3.47m x 2.98m with tiled floor, tiled walls, kitchen cabinets and built in closet. Access to side.

Reception Room 1: 5.48m x 4.68m with carpet, wood panelling, coved ceiling, ceiling rose and American style feature fireplace.
